verdict: Leads up sharply this week; overdue setup milestones remain the open issue.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 95 leads from Meta at an average cost per lead of $13.14 — and over the past 7 days alone, lead volume jumped 47% while cost per lead dropped 38%, even as spend pulled back slightly. That efficiency gain is real and driven by stronger performance within your primary campaign. Day-by-day lead flow has leveled off in the last few days, so we're watching closely to see whether this week's gains hold or need a creative push to sustain them. Separately, a number of planned setup milestones — including landing pages, tracking, search campaigns, and CRM automation — remain outstanding since July–September; completing these is the priority work underway now, as they are the infrastructure needed to run campaigns with full visibility.
